[Issue #9232] Create Opportunity page to use a Query Param for the Agency Id (#9355)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Work for #9232

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->
Change from reading the Agency Id in the URL to using a query param. And
update inbound links into the page.

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
To remove the Agency Id from the URL, files were moved from the
src/app/[locale]/(base)/opportunities/create/[agencyId] folder to the
src/app/[locale]/(base)/opportunities/create folder and the [agencyId]
folder was deleted. Thus, you will not be able to see any code diff. The
main code change was in the definition of the page and assignment of the
agencyId variable:

```
type CreateOpportunityProps = LocalizedPageProps & WithFeatureFlagProps;

async function CreateOpportunityPage(props: CreateOpportunityProps) {
  const { searchParams } = props;
  const resolvedSearchParams: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> =
    searchParams ? await searchParams : {};
  const selectedAgencyParam: string | string[] | undefined =
    resolvedSearchParams.agency;
  const agencyId: string | undefined = Array.isArray(selectedAgencyParam)
    ? selectedAgencyParam[0]
    : selectedAgencyParam;
```

## Validation steps

<!-- Manual testing instructions, as well as any helpful references
(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->
Code review and UAT:

1. Verify that the Create Opportunity button on the Opportunity List
page will correctly take the user to the Create Opportunity page and
default select the agency in the query param.
2. Verify that the page loads with an agency param and the Agency
dropdown default selects that agency. E.g.
http://localhost:3000/opportunities/create?agency=4dcd3a02-60d3-49a9-b2f8-8e42ad8b1a6b
3. Verify that the page loads without an agency param and the Agency
dropdown has no default selection. E.g.
http://localhost:3000/opportunities/create
4. Verify that the page loads even with an invalid agency id or an
agency that the user does not belong to. In this case the Agency
dropdown has no default selection. E.g.
http://localhost:3000/opportunities/create?agency=a-bad-agency-id

---------

jobs

* not all test groups are being run on scheduled jobs

head_commit.message:
Fix 404 pages returning HTTP 200 by using notFound() instead of JSX (#9301)

## Summary
- Pages for opportunities, applications, and forms were returning **HTTP
200** instead of **404** when resources weren't found
- Root cause: components used `return <NotFound />` (renders JSX)
instead of calling `notFound()` (Next.js function that sets the 404
status code)
- Fixed across **4 pages** that had the same bug pattern

## Root cause

```tsx
// Before — renders "not found" UI but HTTP status stays 200
if (parseErrorStatus(error) === 404) {
  return <NotFound />;
}

// After — Next.js sets HTTP 404 and renders the nearest not-found.tsx boundary
if (parseErrorStatus(error) === 404) {
  notFound();
}
```

In Next.js App Router, `notFound()` from `next/navigation` throws a
special error that Next.js catches to:
1. Set the HTTP response status to 404
2. Render the nearest `not-found.tsx` boundary

Simply returning a `<NotFound />` component as JSX renders the UI but
skips the status code — the response is still 200.

## Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `opportunity/[id]/page.tsx` | `return <NotFound />` → `notFound()`,
remove unused import |
| `applications/[applicationId]/page.tsx` | Same fix, add `notFound` to
import |
| `applications/[applicationId]/form/[appFormId]/page.tsx` | Same fix,
add `notFound` to import |
| `print/.../form/[appFormId]/page.tsx` | Same fix, add `notFound` to
import |

## Test plan
- [ ] Visit `/opportunity/359212` (nonexistent int ID) → verify HTTP 404
in Network tab
- [ ] Visit `/opportunity/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`
(nonexistent UUID) → verify HTTP 404
- [ ] Visit a valid opportunity → verify HTTP 200 and content loads
normally
- [ ] Visit `/applications/nonexistent-id` → verify HTTP 404
- [ ] Verify the "not found" UI still renders correctly on all pages

Fixes #5774
